about:
Michigan Fabrications and Maintenance LLC (MFM) operates from Roseville, Michigan. The company has served various industries for roughly the last decade, with a focus on the plating and coating sector. Ownership structure and founding year are not publicly disclosed.

MFM designs and builds new equipment, and also rebuilds and remanufactures existing equipment to improve quality and long-term reliability. The company provides full-service maintenance for plating lines, plating equipment, electrical systems, plumbing, and mechanical components. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

While the firm states it serves many different industries, its stated specialization is the plating and coating industry. Specific customer types or named clients are not provided.

The company emphasizes personal customer service and a commitment to high-quality, reliable equipment and components. No explicit founding mission or differentiator beyond service quality is described.
